6.384 rsBandKeepTogetherIgnored
Applies to RDL 2011/01
rsBandKeepTogetherIgnored is a non-critical error that will occur when a TablixMember.KeepTogether
element is set to true or it is set to an expression for a Tablix that has BandLayoutOptions specified.
